slice: agent event tools real mounting and four publish/subscribe paths
purpose: Mount restricted event tools on real worker sessions and coordinate component/Agent delivery paths with ack vs context-loaded separation, while keeping the H1 core decision zero-tool/single-request invariant.

implementation.workerTools: event-tools.ts adds two restricted worker tools (types/report); publishTypes limited to agent.observation.reported and worker.result.reported; actor/scope/type injected by trusted host principal, arguments may not carry actor/permit/scope/taskId; task.succeeded and unregistered types are rejected.
implementation.mounting: workers.ts attachEventTools(source) accepts one trusted source; each run merges the event tools into the original 3-tool budget and rejects >4 tools before any native Session creation; permit/gate/single-request/authority-key semantics unchanged.
implementation.coordinator: control/events/index.ts adds EventDeliveryCoordinator: component handlers and Agent background references are zero-model; continuation requires a trusted gate; ack and context-loaded are separate; slow/bad consumers are bounded; at-least-once uses deliveryId idempotency; registerAgentTarget/retireAgentTarget prevent retired bindings from regaining qualifications; CoreGoalContinuationTarget re-reads Goal phase/authEpoch/instance/budget and checks the H1 baseline before dispatch, with a confirmed context receipt separate from ack.
implementation.leadIntegration: Lead applied the exact integration diff: TaskWorkerDriver gains an optional attachEventTools; runtime.ts attaches the per-Assignment worker event source right after the durable EventService and before any task can run (failure degrades to lastFailure and event-free workers); runtime.ts creates the empty trusted coordinator and merges its scan into the single existing BackgroundPump consume loop (processed+failed===claimed preserved; no second loop).

runtimeIntegrationTargeted.note: events suites + workers/task-runner/background-pump after Lead integration

fourPaths.agentToComponent: real worker session driver with event tools -> composed model call -> durable SQLite accept (actor=worker:assignment-1, assignment scope) -> zero-model component handler consumes once; duplicate publish is idempotent, no second effect.
fourPaths.componentToComponent: trusted component publish -> zero-model handler consumes once; duplicate/replay/out-of-order and bounded replay expose replayedCount/replayTruncated.
fourPaths.componentToAgent: background mode stores a zero-model reference and acks (wake=0, no context receipt); continuation mode dispatches only after the trusted gate (PAUSED/REVOKED/AUTH_CHANGED/STALE_SESSION/STALE_INSTANCE/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED leave only a background reference and ack without waking); resume never revives old deliveries.
fourPaths.agentToAgent: real worker report -> bound Agent target passes Goal/auth/instance/budget gate -> exactly one native context receipt; worker cannot publish task.succeeded, verification receipts, owner authorization or accounting facts.

verification.negativeMatrix: one-shot/expiry/pause/unsubscribe old deliveries, revocation between gate and dispatch (zero dispatch), ack lost after effect (no duplicate business effect on restart), lost context ack (no duplicate native append), two-store concurrent claim exactly one winner, slow consumer timeout isolation, unregistered handler/binding fail-closed, cross-scope/forged authority/authority-key rejection, pause does not revive.
